explicitly_not_run: Atlas application build or regression suite
Production deployment, portal verification or submission
limitations: Planner checks graph, receipt structure/artifact hashes and Git applicability; not the truth of reported observations or reviewer identity.
Resource locks are advisory scheduling constraints, not OS-enforced protection.
Ancestor evidence requires semantic impact review; final gates require exact HEAD and clean tracked state.
No background execution, agent daemon, blanket permission or auto-deployment is installed.
Current repo files and permissions must be rechecked by the coding agent.
archive_layout: One top-level atlas-execution-kit folder; no root repo configuration overwrites.
